promotion_rule: No task can change from unknown by AI. An appointed human verifier must provide a timestamped, auditable evidence reference; otherwise Target stays Target and Verified is withheld.

controls.unknown_response: HOLD the service claim; retain only a physical, clearly limited alternative where lawful
controls.stale_response: DOWNGRADE to the last valid evidence state and re-verify
controls.rejected_response: STOP the affected pilot/component and publish a physical reroute or unavailable notice
controls.stop_authority: ROLE-02 evidence steward may stop promotion; the accountable ROLE for the work package may stop the concept activation; neither is appointed in this submission

work_package_links.evidence_format: dated route walk, photographs, clearway sketch, maintenance contact record
work_package_links.acceptance_threshold: physical guidance legible AI-OFF and documented clearway unobstructed
work_package_links.response: remove, relocate or HOLD support claim

work_package_links.evidence_format: authorised test-window, public-bypass, buffer and permit-interface record
work_package_links.acceptance_threshold: public bypass and buffer remain separate from test
work_package_links.response: STOP test-facing interface; retain wayfinding only

work_package_links.evidence_format: public-entry, content-rights, maintenance and human-enquiry record
work_package_links.acceptance_threshold: fixed bilingual interpretation and human response work AI-OFF

work_package_links.evidence_format: authorised observation of crossing, legal interface and accessible alternative
work_package_links.acceptance_threshold: documented public, legal and accessible decision sequence

work_package_links.evidence_format: named appointed contact, service-window, physical-sign and AI-OFF exercise log
work_package_links.acceptance_threshold: a person and physical information resolve declared failure
work_package_links.response: DOWNGRADE service statement or STOP point

work_package_links.evidence_format: ledger record, timestamp, geotagged observation, verifier identity and recomputed report
work_package_links.acceptance_threshold: evidence is complete, lawful, current and independently auditable

task_sets.evidence_format: time-stamped route walk, shade photo series and weather note
task_sets.validity_period: one summer season; recheck after canopy/route change
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: human verifier records every declared exposed gap and an authorised physical response
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: HOLD shade continuity; publish only observed exposure/approved detour

task_sets.evidence_format: time-stamped noon walk and exposure log
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: continuous exposure is measured or the limitation is explicitly retained
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: DOWNGRADE from Target to limited route statement; no heat-performance claim

task_sets.evidence_format: route sketch, legal-access observation and accessible-alternative record
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: authorised alternative is public, legible and not represented as verified when incomplete

task_sets.evidence_format: installed-sign photo, bilingual content proof and AI-OFF exercise log
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: fixed signs are readable without phone/screen and do not obstruct clearway
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: STOP marker or retain unbranded physical direction only

task_sets.evidence_format: geotagged photo, public-access observation and map reference
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: concept node is distinguishable from actual accessible location and lawful interface
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: HOLD node activation; retain conceptual mapping only

task_sets.evidence_format: photo, service-hours record, maintenance contact and accessible-use observation
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: facility is available in declared window or is not claimed
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: DOWNGRADE amenity claim; retain rest/water reservation only

task_sets.evidence_format: authorised field observation, legal/public-access record and accessible-alternative record
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: public entry/crossing and lawful accessible alternative are evidenced
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: SUSPEND continuity claim; physically reroute only when authorised

task_sets.evidence_format: appointment record, roster, physical-point photo and AI-OFF drill log
task_sets.acceptance_threshold: appointed human response and physical alternative resolve stated service failure
task_sets.downgrade_hold_response: STOP fallback claim; post authorised physical alternative or unavailable status
